active_initiative: Task 003 (Competitor Observation Engine) shipped on branch ai-queue/003-competitor-observation-engine, based on main at the merge of PR #105. Adds the evidence, confidence, and persistence foundation for competitor observations: supabase/migrations/038_competitor_observations.sql, lib/competitor-observations/types.ts, lib/competitor-observations/scoring.ts (pure, unit-tested scoreCompetitorSignal), lib/competitor-observations/persistence.ts (listCompetitorObservationsForUser, recordCompetitorObservationForUser, generateCompetitorObservationsForUser). Scores lib/market-context/providers/competitorProvider.ts's existing profile-declared signal against an owner's Market Radar tracked competitors (kind: competitor only, not benchmarks); persists only signal clearing an explicit confidence bar (documented thresholds in scoring.ts) as a source-attributed low/medium/high-confidence observation. A fallback/mock signal is never persisted. No UI, no route, no cron wiring, no new external data source or secret. Tasks 001 and 002 (Market Radar persistence + owner-facing view) were already merged (PRs #101, #104) before this task started. Tasks 004 (Business Pulse Integration) and 005 (Weekly Executive Brief section) both depend on this task and are now unblocked.
